method: TRAIN proof-shape induction plus visible-scaffold identifier binding

crdt-type-step: BY DEF TypeOK, Next, Increment, Gossip, vars
crdt-safety-step: BY DEF TypeOK, Safety, Next, Increment, Gossip, vars
crdt-sum-type-proof:
<1>1. IsFiniteSet(DOMAIN f)
    BY NodeAssumption
  <1>2. \A x \in DOMAIN f : f[x] \in Nat
    OBVIOUS
  <1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, SumFunctionNat, SumIsSumFunction
crdt-sum-zero-proof:
<1>1. IsFiniteSet(DOMAIN f)
    BY NodeAssumption
  <1>2. \A x \in DOMAIN f : f[x] \in Nat
    OBVIOUS
  <1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, SumFunctionNat, SumIsSumFunction

<1>1. IsFiniteSet(DOMAIN f)
    BY NodeAssumption
  <1>2. \A x \in DOMAIN f : f[x] \in Nat
    OBVIOUS
  <1>3. DOMAIN f = Node
    OBVIOUS
  <1>. QED  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, SumFunctionZero, SumIsSumFunction
